_note: Fictional agenda for the Quarkus Insights #268 demo (DemoConf 2026, 16 November 2026). Speakers and talks are made up, except "Practical MCP Security in Action", which the demos and tests rely on. One speaker per session.

speakers.name: Willem Jan Glerum
speakers.bio: Principal Software Engineer at Lunatech. Focused on Quarkus, cloud, and security.

speakers.name: Noor Vermeulen
speakers.bio: Java platform engineer who likes fast feedback loops and slow coffee.

speakers.name: Tomasz Kowalczyk
speakers.bio: Backend developer working on streaming data and the newest JDK features.

speakers.name: Lena Hartmann
speakers.bio: Site reliability engineer, collector of incident postmortems.

speakers.name: Sofia Marques
speakers.bio: Security engineer focused on identity and OAuth.

speakers.name: Daan de Boer
speakers.bio: Tech lead who keeps legacy systems alive and well.

speakers.name: Mei Tanaka
speakers.bio: Machine learning engineer building agents on the JVM.

speakers.name: Jonas Lindqvist
speakers.bio: Build tooling enthusiast and Maven plugin author.

speakers.name: Pieter Claes
speakers.bio: Database engineer, fan of boring and correct.

sessions.title: Opening Keynote: Building Software People Can Trust
sessions.speaker: Ravi Menon
sessions.abstract: Why trust is the feature users notice last and miss first, and how teams earn it one release at a time.

sessions.title: Fast Feedback with Continuous Testing
sessions.speaker: Noor Vermeulen
sessions.abstract: Keep your tests running while you type and stop waiting on CI to tell you what you already broke.

sessions.title: Designing for Accessibility from Day One
sessions.speaker: Amara Okafor
sessions.abstract: Small habits that make every screen usable for everyone, without a separate project at the end.

sessions.title: Event-Driven Without the Confusion
sessions.speaker: Pieter Claes
sessions.abstract: Who owns which data when every service listens to every event.

sessions.title: OAuth 2.1 Without the Headaches
sessions.speaker: Sofia Marques
sessions.abstract: Authorization code with PKCE, refresh tokens and audiences, explained with one running example.

sessions.title: Taming a Legacy Monolith
sessions.speaker: Daan de Boer
sessions.abstract: Strangling a ten-year-old codebase one module at a time while it keeps shipping every week.

sessions.title: Agents on the JVM
sessions.speaker: Mei Tanaka
sessions.abstract: How tool calling, memory and guardrails fit together when you build an AI agent in Java.

sessions.title: Getting More out of Your Build
sessions.speaker: Jonas Lindqvist
sessions.abstract: Incremental builds, reproducible artifacts and the plugins that quietly slow you down.

sessions.title: Tracing a Request Across Ten Services
sessions.speaker: Hana Novak
sessions.abstract: OpenTelemetry from first span to a dashboard the on-call engineer actually opens.

sessions.title: Postgres Tricks for Application Developers
sessions.speaker: Pieter Claes
sessions.abstract: Indexes, constraints and transactions that save you from writing that code yourself.

sessions.title: Startup Time in the Age of Disposable Infrastructure
sessions.speaker: Lena Hartmann
sessions.abstract: Native images, AOT caching and checkpoints compared on the same service.

sessions.title: Prompt Injection, Explained
sessions.speaker: Sofia Marques
sessions.abstract: How untrusted text steers a model, and the defences that hold up when a tool can act.

sessions.title: Practical MCP Security in Action
sessions.speaker: Willem Jan Glerum
sessions.abstract: Securing MCP servers with OAuth 2.1, token exchange and step-up authentication, live with Quarkus and Keycloak.

sessions.title: Stream Gatherers in Practice
sessions.speaker: Tomasz Kowalczyk
sessions.abstract: Custom intermediate operations for Java streams: windowing, deduplication and stateful pipelines with Gatherers.

sessions.title: Testing AI Features Beyond the Demo
sessions.speaker: Mei Tanaka
sessions.abstract: Evaluation sets, regression checks and what to assert when the output is never the same twice.

sessions.title: Native Images Without Tears
sessions.speaker: Lena Hartmann
sessions.abstract: A practical checklist for moving a real service to a native executable.

sessions.title: Kubernetes for Java Developers
sessions.speaker: Ravi Menon
sessions.abstract: Probes, resources and config maps: the parts of Kubernetes your Java app has opinions about.

sessions.title: Code Review That Helps
sessions.speaker: Noor Vermeulen
sessions.abstract: Reviews that catch bugs, share knowledge and do not leave anyone dreading the next pull request.
